data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is technical, not substantive. qwen3-235b encountered an API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) when auditing .gitignore, forcing an inconclusive verdict. deepseek-v4-flash successfully reviewed all 5 files including .gitignore and found it to be a standard gitignore file with no security implications. coverage_issues: qwen3-235b failed to review .gitignore due to API error (HTTP 400), but this is a non-executable configuration file with no security relevance
learnings: API errors on non-executable files (like .gitignore, .desktop, .SRCINFO) should not force an inconclusive verdict when all executable files (PKGBUILD, install scripts, launcher scripts) have been successfully reviewed

The audit tool should distinguish between critical files (PKGBUILD, .install, executable scripts) and metadata/config files (.gitignore, .desktop, .SRCINFO) when determining if coverage gaps warrant an inconclusive verdict
Implement retry logic or fallback handling for transient API errors to prevent unnecessary inconclusive verdicts
